issues: Meaning drift/omission: the phrase "Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimation Agains Women" in Law No. 7/1984 is omitted from the translation (only the Indonesian title is translated).
Meaning drift/typo not corrected: "200G" in the translation should be "2006" to match the original ("200G" is a source typo for 2006).
Meaning drift: "Formulation of Legislation" should be "Formation of Laws and Regulations" (Pembentukan Peraturan Perundang-Undangan).

Meaning drift/term error: “Unit Kerja Perangkat Daerah (UKPD)” is mistranslated as “Regional Apparatus Work Unit” (same as SKPD); it should be “Regional Apparatus Work Unit Unit”/“Regional Apparatus Work Unit (UKPD)” i.e., a different term from SKPD (Unit Kerja vs Satuan Kerja).

Meaning drift/omission of structure: the definition for “Petugas pelaksana...” and the separate definition “Pelayanan...” are merged into one sentence, obscuring that “Service (Pelayanan)” is a separate defined term.
Minor meaning drift: “harkat dan martabat kemanusiaan” is rendered as “human dignity and dignity” (duplicative); should be “human dignity and worth” (or equivalent).

Meaning drift/terminology: "Kabupaten Layak Anak" should be rendered as "Child-Friendly District/Regency" (KLA), not "Child-Friendly Regency" (regency is already implied by Kabupaten; standard term is District/Regency but keep consistent).

Minor meaning/structure issue: In Article 1, the Indonesian text has a run-on where the definition of "Petugas pelaksana..." and "Pelayanan" are in one paragraph; translation splits them into two separate definitions without reflecting the original formatting. This can affect downstream boundary detection if definitions are expected to be in the same paragraph block.

Scrambled list/numbering structure: Article 9 in the original is a single sentence followed by a list of efforts separated by semicolons; the translation keeps the content but loses the list-item markers/structure (no lettered items), which can break downstream boundary-based retrieval.
Meaning/structure drift: Article 13 first paragraph merges two sentences without a clear break (missing period after “community-based”), making the legal structure unclear compared to the original.

Scrambled list/numbering structure: Article 9 in the original is written as a continuous series of efforts separated by semicolons, but the translation converts it into lettered items (a–h), adding list markers not present in the original and changing the structure used for downstream splitting.

Broken Markdown structure: several level-5 headings in the original are not kept as headings in the translation (e.g., "Pembina Tk.I/IV.b", "Salinan sesuai dengan aslinya" are plain paragraphs instead of "#####" headings).
Meaning drift: "Pembina Tk.I/IV.b" is left untranslated (should be rendered in English, or at least indicated as a rank/grade).

Broken Markdown structure: original has headings '##### PENJELASAN', '##### ATAS', '##### PERATURAN DAERAH KABUPATEN LAMPUNG TIMUR', '##### NOMOR  15   TAHUN 2012', '##### TENTANG', '##### PERLIDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK', '##### DI KABUPATEN LAMPUNG TIMUR' which are not preserved as separate headings in the translation (collapsed/changed to different wording).

Meaning drift: 'PERATURAN DAERAH KABUPATEN LAMPUNG TIMUR' translated as 'REGIONAL REGULATION OF EAST LAMPUNG REGENCY' (should be Lampung Timur Regency, not East Lampung Regency, to match the proper name used elsewhere and the Indonesian text).
Leftover non-legal commentary at end of translation: "This excerpt sits under: CHAPTER X > CLOSING PROVISIONS" is not in the original text.
Minor meaning drift/awkwardness in Article 10 Paragraph (3): "with professional recommendation" should reflect "based on professional recommendation" (berdasarkan rekomendasi profesional).
